profile.summary: North Region SELPA (Special Education Local Plan Area) is a multi-district cooperative in northern Alameda County. Five school districts (Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Emery and Piedmont Unified) work together through it to coordinate programs and services for students with disabilities.
